# platform.ModelSettings

<!-- Generated by `pnpm contracts:catalog`. Do not edit. -->

The model each role of the agent runtime runs on, and the price of each model.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `platform.ModelSettings` |
| Kind | `entity` |
| PII | `none` |
| Tenancy scope | `platform` |
| Permission | `platform.model.manage` |

## Fields

| Field | Required | PII | Description | UI |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `aiMode` | yes | `none` | Mode of the runtime; in fake mode the roles run scripted models. |  |
| `models` | yes | `none` | Priced models a role may run on. |  |
| `roles` | yes | `none` | Every model role with its current model. |  |
| `updatedAt` | yes | `none` | When staff last saved the settings (UTC); null when never. |  |
